name: NSW Government
body: Every image has alt text, security.txt is published, and JSON-LD names the GovernmentOrganization. But 8 of 16 images on the home page carry no width or height, so the browser cannot reserve their space.
lesson: Set width and height (or CSS aspect-ratio) on every image, so the layout does not jump as they load.
summary: www.nsw.gov.au scores 81 out of 100 (B). 2 checks fail now, 17 are at risk, and 18 pass. Fix first: no content security policy.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 14 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 13 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: /living-nsw Article lacks author, /living-in-nsw/information-for-aboriginal-people Article lacks author, /community-services Article lacks author and 10 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager, Adobe Analytics appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: The start page took 2700 ms to arrive
fix.evidence: That is the HTML alone, before images and scripts.
fix.fix: Cache the HTML at the edge, or speed up the server render.

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 38/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 15.6 s, Total Blocking Time 853 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0, Speed Index 8.1 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

fix.title: 10 pages took longer than 1.8 s
fix.evidence: /living-in-nsw/information-for-aboriginal-people (1820 ms), /community-services (5301 ms), /driving-boating-and-transport (2915 ms), /education-and-training (3752 ms) and 6 more.
fix.fix: Profile those templates; they are slower than the rest of the site.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
